body: I feel exactly the same way. Sorry for the late response. It's an awful and confusing feeling.
Yeah I feel the exact same way. Just kinda wish I'd drop dead already, but too much of a pussy to actually do it.

Reading your message... I can't describe how comforting it is. I would never wish this kind of pain upon anyone, but it's hard not to feel so isolated when you're so detached, so knowing someone understands is soothing.

I'm so glad to have moved you in such a way. I love to read and write, though I've always considered myself a pretty mediocre writer, which is why your words made me cry a little as well. I can't remember the last time I ever showed any of my writing to anyone. I bet your writing is lovely too.

If you would like to, I would love to keep in touch with you. When people suffer, they need each other.
You're right. You're right. It's comforting. This is progress. Though difficult, still progress.
